title: Reading repeated recursive work
description: You can locate the two calls that may search the same list tail.

steps.description: largest accepts a list L. For a one-element list, you return its first element.
The comparison computes the largest value in the rest of L. If the first element is at least that value, you return the first element.

steps.question: When the comparison is false, does this branch reuse its recursive result?
steps.answer: No. It calls largest on the same cdr again, repeating that recursive search.

steps.description: You can identify the repeated tail call in the definition. This snippet defines largest without calling it, and the supplied output is blank.
